messages.subject: Re: passing a plot object to rook
parts:
Here's an example that does something similar to what you want. I just
committed it to github, so you won't have it on your system:

https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rRack/blob/master/Rook/inst/exampleApps/rnorm.R

If you have RCurl installed then it's just a matter of doing this in
your R session:

library(RCurl)
library(Rook)
eval(parse(text=getURL('https://github.com/jeffreyhorner/rRack/raw/master/Rook/inst/exampleApps/rnorm.R')))
s <- Rhttpd$new()
s$add(name='rnorm',app=app)
s$start()
s$browse(1)

Let me know if you need help getting it going.

Jeff

messages.author: dac343502ff19904
messages.subject: Re: passing a plot object to rook
parts:
Just for fun, here is how one way to do this with gWidgetsWWW2:

f <- tempfile()
width <- height <- 400

make_plot <- function(a, lb, ub) {
if(is.na(a) || is.na(lb) || is.na(ub))
return()

canvas(f, width=width, height=height)
FUN <- function(x) x^a
curve(FUN, lb, ub)
dev.off()
svalue(cv) <- f # assign to gcanvas object
}


w <- gwindow("Plot example")
gstatusbar("Powered by gWidgetsWWW2 and Rook", cont=w)
pg <- gpanedgroup(cont=w)
cv <- gcanvas(width=width, height=height, cont=pg)

g <- gframe("Parameters:", cont=pg, horizontal=FALSE)
tbl <- glayout(cont=g)
tbl[1,1] <- "a:"
tbl[1,2] <- (a <- gedit("1", cont=tbl))
tbl[2,1] <- "lower:"
tbl[2,2] <- (lb <- gedit("0", cont=tbl))
tbl[3,1] <- "upper:"
tbl[3,2] <- (ub <- gedit("2", cont=tbl))
visible(tbl) <- TRUE

gseparator(cont=g)
b <- gbutton("plot", cont=g)

plotHandler <- function(h,...) {
vals <- sapply(list(a, lb, ub), function(i) as.numeric(svalue(i)),
simplify=FALSE)
do.call("make_plot", vals)
}
addHandlerClicked(b, handler=plotHandler)
## initial plot
plotHandler(NULL)

messages.subject: Re: passing a plot object to rook
parts:
OK I finally found it!
the code for 'app' has to be replaced by:

app <- function(env){
req <- Rook::Request$new(env)
res <- Rook::Response$new()
friend <- 'World'
if (!is.null(req$GET()[['friend']]))
friend <- req$GET()[['friend']]
res$write(paste('<h1>Hello',friend,'</h1>\n'))

res$write(paste('<img src="file:///',getwd(),'/
myplot.jpeg"','>',sep='')) #code that is supposed to load myplot.jpg

res$write('What is your name? ')
res$write('<form method="GET"> ')
res$write('<input type="text" name="friend"> ')
res$write('<input type="submit" name="Submit"> </form>
<br>')
res$finish()

}
Sam
